name: Tania
review: AMAZING place! Such a beautiful home, and words can’t fully explain the wonderful experience we had. This is a stay we’ll always remember. We would love to come back!

name: Mary
review: We absolutely loved our home away from home.  Everything was perfect from the minute we got there. We had clean towels and the beds were comfortable. The setting was beautiful. We would definitely stay there again.

name: Megan
review: Everything was great. Andrey was awesome from the moment I first started the booking process. The yard was perfect for the dogs, they tired themselves out swimming and running around all day. Everything was spotless, had lots of kitchen amenities, lots of firewood for the fire pits and the most comfortable couch ever. Highly recommend for families with pets! Would definitely rebook.

name: Jack
review: Fantastic stay, house has everything you need. 5/5

name: Kelsey
review: We had a wonderful stay, and we look forward to possibly staying there next year!

name: Stephanie
review: Loved staying in this cozy, peaceful space. It was outfitted with everything we needed, and the view was icing on the cake.

name: Yolanda
review:
My family and I had a wonderful, relaxing 3 days at this beautiful house.  We hope to come back soon. The house has anything you could possibly need.  Modern appliances, plenty of towels, blankets, etc.
I will recommend it to my friends!

name: Jessica
review: This was an awesome getaway. The house is really clean, and functional. There was lots of great little details in the house like chargers, kayaks, games etc. The pond was great, lots of fun catching fish and paddle boarding.

name: Patricia
review:
Nice house. The place was clean and spacious. They provided everything including coffee and laundry/dish soap. When we struggled with the air conditioning situation he was prompt in helping us figure things out. 
If I had to find some negatives, I would mention it is a decent walk down a slope to get to the water but that is to be expected at most lakes. I had no problem with it but some in our group struggled. 
Another thing, just an FYI, it is located on a fairly busy road so a bit noisy if you’re on the deck but not down by the water. There are a lot of trees so privacy is not an issue, however. Overall, we were quite pleased with this home and would definitely recommend staying here.

name: Morgan
review: Our family had a wonderful stay at Andrey’s place. The lakeside setting is pristine, with plenty to do from kayaking, to swimming, to fishing, to mornings with coffee on the deck, and evenings by the fire. This was the most thoughtfully-equipped vacation rental we’ve stayed in and felt right at home. We hope to return. Thanks for a great stay!

name: Jenna
review: The house was perfect for weekend getaway. Very comfortable, beautiful view of the pond, and access to the water is a huge bonus. We wish we had planned a longer trip and would happily go back!

name: Alexandra
review: We had a great stay at Andrey’s place. The house was clean and bright and comfortable and well stocked. The walk down to the water is a ways from the house, which you can seen in the photos, but walking back up the hill is a hike. The dock and floating dock were great, and the water was very clear. The stairs into the water from the dock weren’t bolted in, so we did need to be very careful when using them. The couch was perfect for movie nights. The location being so close to Augusta was great for eating out and grocery shopping. Andrey was super responsive when we had a question about the air conditioning. Overall, if you’re looking for a place to relax by the water, I would recommend.

name: Carolyn
review: Andrey's house was one of the cleanest, most comfortable Airbnb's we've stayed at. There was space enough for everyone to spread out. The weather was particularly hot in late June and the AC was controllable in each room. There are also TVs in each room -- great for all of us including the kiddo! The beds are very comfortable and that couch in the living room -- I must have one! And, our senior lab was very comfortable as well!  A special bonus was the downstairs playroom -- perfect for our 3 1/2 year old grandson to run around with us and play. And the setting is beautiful -- right on the lake. We swam, kayaked, looked for fish and barbequed! Andrey checked in with use during our stay and was very informative and warm.  What a wonderful stay and ideal location between August and the Midcoast area. We can't wait to stay again!

name: Helen
review: My family and I had such an incredible time staying at Andrey’s property! The view was stunning, and the house was immaculate. Sitting on the deck enjoying coffee was amazing, and the added kayaks were a great touch! We will definitely be coming back in the future :) Thanks again Andrey!

name: Brian
review: Such a great spot to come back to after a day of adventure or for a day of relaxing.

name: Tanya
review: The house was set on a beautiful, super quiet pond. Our children loved using the kayaks and the fishing was excellent. House had what we needed and was very clean.  Also some great tech upgrades that we all enjoyed. Sitting out on the deck having our morning coffee or a glass of wine was so relaxing! Easy location to run errands and travel to see nearby towns in Maine as well. Andrey was a great host and super helpful!

name: Suguna
review: We had a lovely time at the house with the kids and the pups.  The kayaks and paddleboard were a great draw; we spent most of the time on the water.. would definitely go back!!

name: April
review: Everything was great!

name: John
review: Thank you for an incredible stay. So spacious and met all of our needs. Easy to communicate with the owner. It was a home away from home and very clean! We will be staying again!

name: Brianna
review: Our stay at Andrey’s house was amazing and exceeded all our expectations. The home was spotless, comfortable, and fully stocked with all the amenities we needed. The space was perfect for our family—spacious, cozy, and thoughtfully set up. We especially loved the back deck and the beautiful yard that led down to a picturesque pond—such a peaceful setting to relax and enjoy nature. Andrey was a fantastic host: accommodating, responsive, and ready to help if needed. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing getaway!

name: Robin
review:
Andrey was so nice and she cared about our stay and what we needed.  The house was beautiful and my family and I really enjoyed it.  Walmart delivery to the house was very helpful due to our time schedule and hectic schedule. The weather was cold so we didn't get to enjoy the lake but we did walk the lighted path to see it.  I would highly recommend this home for a relaxing, peaceful stay!  I LOVED the comfy couch and the beds were so comfortable. 
I would definitely rent this home again!  Thanks Audrey for everything!

name: Susie
review:
We had a terrific time at Andrey’s house. The kitchen is fantastic and the common spaces are well appointed. 
The lake was a bit of a hike for us old folks, but, it was beautiful. 
Interestingly, there is road noise, but not in the house, only outside. 
Comfy beds, well appointed toilets (toilet seat warmer and a bidet!!), TVs in every bedroom and space for solitude and gathering. 
Perfect.

name: Donna
review: This was a beautiful space! The morning sunrises were amazing and the house was clean and inviting. You had everything you needed - from a full kitchen, to plenty of towels, to safe outdoor lighting for parking, nice bathroom facilities and TVs in every room. There were even charging cables available all through out and my favorite - outdoor boots for exploring the property and going down to the lake - amazing. Will definitely stay again.

name: Amanda
review: For to be a first timer to book on Airbnb it was an amazing experience. Andrey was an amazing host. She responded in a timely fashion and was very polite. The house is a beautiful place to stay at felt like home to us. We will definitely be booking there to stay again in the future maybe when it’s warmer lol but it was an amazing view of the pond behind the house and so peaceful and beautiful. Thank you Andrey for allowing us to stay at your amazing Airbnb it was a joy to stay there!

name: Lee
review: You couldn’t ask for a more comfortable, clean, convenient place. Rowell equipped. Lovely water views to wake up to. Andrey was a thoughtful attentive host.

name: Elizabeth
review:
Wow, just wow.
What an amazing place that make traveling so easy. The kitchen is well stocked with the basics, the house is super clean and inviting, the location on the lake was perfect. 
Thank you and I hope I can find a reason to come back to Maine soon!

name: Kim
review: We had a wonderful stay! The house was warm, relaxing, and truly felt like a home away from home. Everything we needed was available, and Andrey was incredibly accommodating and easy to work with whenever we had questions. We look forward to staying here again the next time we’re in Maine!

name: Doug
review: The house and location were great for a few day vacation.  The house was extremely clean and comfortable.  My son and I caught at least 40 bass, including a couple of 4 lb. Largemouth.  Would definitely stay here again.

name: Michael
review: The place was very nice and beautiful right on the lake. Host was very response immediately upon arrival. would not hesitate to book here again

name: Sepehr
review:
My partner and I visited Maine for a peaceful getaway, and was exactly the place we were looking for.
This spot is absolutely beautiful with the easy access to the lake and the peacefulness of nature, the home being spotless and had everything a couple would need, and Andrey was responsive and helpful too. We had issues with arrivals and he was accommodating and friendly.
Would definitely return again. Thank you Andrey

name: Shahnaz
review:
WHAT A HIDDEN GEM! Worth every penny!
This place is absolutely stunningly homey
We had a short trip but packed schedule during our stay and it's always really nice in the end of the day we're looking forward to go "home".
Very family friendly, we brought a dog, my mother, my husband and a toddler. All sleep very well that really surprised me, because you know with toddler everything is unpredictable 😂
This place is so close to get local food or groceries, so close to get to nice places in Camden, Augusta it self, rockland, rockport, fairfield, very strategic location but still wooded and yet homey. 
Also fast internetttt and dog bowls, dog's towels 
Lots of children books, disney movie and kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need even a bottle of wine ! Woww 😂 
Very easy check in, the house is so cozy. Oh did I mentioned about the couch? I fell asleep on it on the daytime because so fluffy and cozy, I'd bring em home if I could lol
The place is spotless 😍❤️

name: Amy & Jim
review: Fantastic location with very friendly, welcoming and responsive host. Would love to stay again.
